```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03", "04"),
  packages = c("here", "dplyr", "knitr", "kableExtra", "tableone", "survival"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
# The cohort is `data_complete` from script 04: the complete-case cohort of the
# economic survival models (complete on age, sex, arm, week-4 CRP, TMB/BRAF and
# both endpoints). TLR completeness is NOT required (issue #157); the patients
# without a TLR reading (early deaths before the first on-treatment CT) are
# shown as "Not assessed".
n_total <- nrow(data_complete)
n_tlr_missing <- sum(is.na(data_complete$tlr))
arm_levels <- levels(data_complete$Rx)

cat("Patients in the economic complete-case cohort:", n_total, "\n")
cat("Without TLR:", n_tlr_missing, "\n")
cat("Treatment arms:", paste(arm_levels, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r build-table, include=FALSE}
# ---- Baseline characteristics (tableone, with between-arm tests) -------------
# `sex` is the trial column "Sex 0female": level "1" is male.
tlr_num <- as.numeric(as.character(data_complete$tlr))
table_data <- data_complete %>%
  mutate(
    `Treatment Arm` = Rx,
    `Age (years)` = Age,
    Sex = ifelse(as.numeric(as.character(sex)) == 1, "Male", "Female"),
    `CRP-positive (<5 mg/L, week 4)` =
      ifelse(as.numeric(as.character(crp)) == 1, "Yes", "No"),
    `TMB/BRAF-positive` =
      ifelse(as.numeric(as.character(tmb_braf)) == 1, "Yes", "No"),
    `TLR-positive (>=10%, first on-treatment CT)` = factor(
      ifelse(is.na(tlr_num), "Not assessed", ifelse(tlr_num == 1, "Yes", "No")),
      levels = c("Yes", "No", "Not assessed")
    )
  )

baseline_vars <- c("Age (years)", "Sex", "CRP-positive (<5 mg/L, week 4)",
                   "TMB/BRAF-positive",
                   "TLR-positive (>=10%, first on-treatment CT)")
cat_vars <- setdiff(baseline_vars, "Age (years)")

tab1 <- CreateTableOne(
  vars = baseline_vars,
  strata = "Treatment Arm",
  data = table_data,
  factorVars = cat_vars,
  addOverall = TRUE
)

tab1_df <- print(tab1, showAllLevels = TRUE, quote = FALSE,
                 noSpaces = TRUE, printToggle = FALSE)

# ---- Follow-up and outcomes: descriptive only, no tests ----------------------
# OS and PFS are censored times, so they are not summarised as mean (SD) nor
# tested with oneway.test (issue #157). Follow-up is the reverse Kaplan-Meier
# median (censoring treated as the event); survival medians are Kaplan-Meier
# estimates with 95% CI.
arm_sets <- c(list(Overall = data_complete), split(data_complete, data_complete$Rx))

fq <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "NR", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))
}
reverse_km_row <- function(d, time, event) {
  t <- d[[time]]; e <- 1 - d[[event]]
  q <- quantile(survfit(Surv(t, e) ~ 1), probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))$quantile
  sprintf("%s (%s to %s)", fq(q[2]), fq(q[1]), fq(q[3]))
}
km_median_row <- function(d, time, event) {
  t <- d[[time]]; e <- d[[event]]
  tab <- summary(survfit(Surv(t, e) ~ 1))$table
  sprintf("%s (%s to %s)", fq(tab[["median"]]), fq(tab[["0.95LCL"]]),
          fq(tab[["0.95UCL"]]))
}
events_row <- function(d, event) {
  sprintf("%d (%.1f)", sum(d[[event]]), 100 * mean(d[[event]]))
}

outcome_rows <- rbind(
  "Follow-up for survival, weeks (median (IQR), reverse Kaplan-Meier)" =
    sapply(arm_sets, reverse_km_row, time = "OSwk", event = "Death"),
  "Deaths (n (%))" = sapply(arm_sets, events_row, event = "Death"),
  "Progression or death (n (%))" =
    sapply(arm_sets, events_row, event = "Progression"),
  "Overall survival, weeks (Kaplan-Meier median (95% CI))" =
    sapply(arm_sets, km_median_row, time = "OSwk", event = "Death"),
  "Progression-free survival, weeks (Kaplan-Meier median (95% CI))" =
    sapply(arm_sets, km_median_row, time = "PFSwk", event = "Progression")
)

arm_cols <- setdiff(colnames(tab1_df), c("level", "p", "test"))
stopifnot(all(arm_cols %in% colnames(outcome_rows)))
outcome_mat <- cbind(level = "", outcome_rows[, arm_cols, drop = FALSE],
                     p = "", test = "")[, colnames(tab1_df), drop = FALSE]

tab_df <- rbind(tab1_df, outcome_mat)
n_baseline <- nrow(tab1_df)
```

```{r display-table}
kable(tab_df,
      caption = sprintf("Table S1: Patient characteristics, follow-up and outcomes by treatment arm (n = %d)", n_total),
      format = "html") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12) %>%
  pack_rows("Baseline characteristics", 1, n_baseline) %>%
  pack_rows("Follow-up and outcomes (descriptive, no tests)",
            n_baseline + 1, nrow(tab_df)) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      sprintf("Data from the METIMMOX trial (NCT03388190). n = %d: the complete-case cohort of the economic survival models (complete on age, sex, arm, week-4 CRP, TMB/BRAF and both endpoints). TLR was not assessed in %d of these patients (early deaths before the first on-treatment CT).",
              n_total, n_tlr_missing),
      "Baseline characteristics: mean (SD) or n (%); p-values from the chi-squared test (categorical variables; the TLR test compares all three levels including Not assessed) or the t-test (age). Follow-up and outcome rows are descriptive only: follow-up is the reverse Kaplan-Meier median with interquartile range, survival medians are Kaplan-Meier estimates with 95% CI, NR = not reached; no p-values are reported for censored outcomes.",
      "CRP = C-reactive protein; TLR = target lesion reduction; TMB = tumor mutational burden.",
      "Biomarker definitions: CRP-positive (CRP <5.0 mg/L at week 4, before the first nivolumab dose); TMB/BRAF-positive (TMB >=9 mut/Mb or BRAF V600E); TLR-positive (>=10% reduction at the first on-treatment CT; an on-treatment measure, described here only and excluded from the economic model)."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("outputs", "tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) {
  dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

write.csv(tab_df, file = here("outputs", "tables", "table_s1.csv"))
cat("Table saved to:", here("outputs", "tables", "table_s1.csv"), "\n")
```

Table S1 has been saved to `outputs/tables/table_s1.csv`.
